items.question: What is a seamless carousel post?
items.answer: A seamless carousel is a social media post (typically on Instagram or LinkedIn) consisting of multiple slides where the background or visual elements flow continuously from one slide to the next, creating a single panoramic experience when swiped.

items.question: How does Lovart ensure the images align perfectly?
items.answer: Lovart utilizes an 'Infinite Canvas' approach. Instead of designing separate squares, you design on one continuous panoramic layout. The AI then assists in placing elements across the cuts, ensuring pixel-perfect alignment when uploaded.

items.question: Can I maintain consistent characters across the carousel slides?
items.answer: Yes, utilizing our 'Flux Context' or 'Nano Banana' models, Lovart excels at character consistency. You can define a subject once and the AI will render them consistently across different poses and scenes throughout your carousel story.

items.question: Does Lovart help with the text and story planning?
items.answer: Absolutely. As an AI Design Agent, Lovart doesn't just generate images; it can help structure your narrative arc, suggest hooks for the first slide, and draft accompanying text that fits the visual layout.

items.question: Can I edit specific elements after generating the carousel?
items.answer: Yes, with our 'Edit Elements' and 'Touch Edit' features, you can select any specific part of the carousel—like a text block or a background object—and modify, move, or regenerate it without affecting the rest of the design.
